note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative: the performances are generic placeholders, never real contract text. "Linked" and "listed" are supplied, neutral configurations of equal weight: they only say whether the supplied links are drawn between the two columns. A link means only "linked as supplied": no exchange that is due, no condition, no dependency, no order of performance, no breach, remedy or termination, and no jurisdiction is stated. Obligation A and obligation B have equal weight, size and timing. Brief customizable fields not exposed (coordinator decision BRIEF CUSTOMIZABLE FIELDS, SESSION_HANDOFF 2026-10-05): clauses (the performances stand for the clauses: performancesA / performancesB), schedules, definitions and priorities (no priority between the columns is drawn: neither side is primary).
